failure: Failure: The -590.5 per mil source value is model-dependent and unstable as D/L approaches one; the uncertainty fit prevents treating it as a required exotic reservoir. The closed-pool racemization bound is not an age estimate and does not apply to open histories. This does not establish contamination, overturn the source paper, or identify a chemical history.
interface: Interface: Mix isotope delta values only after conversion to heavy-atom fractions q=R/(1+R), R=R_AIR(1+delta/1000). The racemization inequality assumes a closed pool without later formation, exchange, selective destruction or protected compartments. The one-source invariant assumes the stated background/source mixture and isotope-independent racemization. The printed measurement uncertainties use different definitions and raw replicate covariance was unavailable.

claims.title: Closed-pool racemization and a source-mixture invariant constrain Bennu glutamate histories
